strings.zh: 你去过紫苑镇了吗？{NEWLINE}很多灵异事件的传说都跟那里有关哦。
strings.en: Have you been to Lavender Town? Lots{NEWLINE}of ghost stories come from there.

strings.zh: 不好意思啊,{NEWLINE}现在金黄市全面……
strings.en: Sorry. Saffron City is under full...

strings.zh: 啊！您是菊子大人说的{NEWLINE}那几位年轻训练家之一！{SCROLL}既然如此您请过吧！
strings.en: Oh! You’re one of the young Trainers{NEWLINE}Agatha mentioned!{SCROLL}In that case, please, go right ahead!

strings.zh: 对不起啊,{NEWLINE}接到上面的命令现在要戒严,{CLEAR}金黄市暂时禁止进入。
strings.en: Sorry. We’re under lockdown by orders{NEWLINE}from above.{SCROLL}Saffron City is closed for now.
